description: Custom domains for SaaS users: an HTTP API, a remote MCP server and one-file server SDKs that find a domain's DNS provider, create or list the DNS records and confirm propagation.
rules: Keep CNAMIO_SECRET on the server only; browsers get 60-minute session tokens from POST https://api.cnamio.com/token.
Build the DNS records per user with recordsForUser (Node.js) or records_for_user (Python): a CNAME plus an ownership TXT.
Treat the domain.added webhook, verified over the raw body with CNAMIO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, as the only proof a domain is connected.
Pass a DNS provider API token straight to connectAutomatic; never store or log it.
Without credentials, use the sandbox session from POST https://api.cnamio.com/v1/agent/sandbox; nothing real is read or written.
There is no npm or PyPI package yet: save https://cnamio.com/sdk/cnamio.mjs or https://cnamio.com/sdk/cnamio.py into the project.
